note: Registered a-priori variant values for WD-01-PA2G-LC2 (REGISTRATION_PA2G_LC2.md section 2). SEPARATE from params_nominal.json (which stays byte-identical, LF-sha256 079a5576...). Every variant is OFF by default; the ONE registered value per variant is never tuned, swept or selected. The engine reads the 'lc_variants' section only when a caller injects it via partA_v2g.variants.variant_params(); with the section absent (nominal params file) every flag is off.

va_persistence.rule: a discretionary change fires only if the MOBIL criterion (incentive + safety) has held continuously for T_persist_s (4 steps at dt 0.5 s)
va_persistence.provenance: standard anti-flicker / decision-persistence device; value = 4 integration steps, chosen a priori, NOT fitted

vb_manoeuvre.rule: after any lane change the same vehicle may not start another DISCRETIONARY change for T_lc_s (the change itself stays instantaneous; mandatory merges unaffected)
vb_manoeuvre.provenance: empirical lane-change durations reported around 4-5 s (Toledo & Zohar 2007, 'to verify' citation flag per registration); value chosen a priori, NOT fitted

vc_early_merge.rule: an accel-lane vehicle applies the mandatory-merge rule from the START of the merge zone with zero incentive threshold, plus b_merge_mps2 added to its MOBIL gain toward main_right; the safety test is unchanged
vc_early_merge.provenance: on-ramp bias convention of Treiber/Kesting-style MOBIL implementations; value chosen a priori, NOT fitted
